verdict.rationale: TeamViewer's pricing page lists a first-party "Mobile SDK (add-on)", so an official SDK exists. The evidence is only a one-line pricing entry with no SDK documentation, language coverage, or developer guidance. The Web API docs describe a REST API, not an SDK, and probes found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt to support generated clients. Missing for 10: documented SDK reference and languages, scope beyond mobile, SDK coverage of the Web API, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
